data: What is the BLEU score of Model II when λ is 0.9 on the EN-DE validate set?

The question asks for the BLEU score of Model II when λ is 0.9 on the EN-DE validate set. From the caption, we know that the figure shows BLEU scores for three models: Trans.base, +Model I, and +Model II, across two datasets: EN-DE and ZH-EN. The right subfigure corresponds to the EN-DE dataset, and the red line represents +Model II. At λ = 0.9, the red line (representing +Model II) intersects with the y-axis at approximately 23.5. Therefore, the BLEU score of Model II when λ is 0.9 on the EN-DE validate set is approximately 23.5.
